text: If you have this kind of arrangement, then every antenna at the transmitter can send a signal to the corresponding antenna at the receiver. And since the antennas are spaced by at least this distance, these signals will travel over independent channels. So the propagation of these signals is independent one from the other. They will be independent. In this case, you can provide a string of bits, zero, one, one, zero, whatever, to this antenna as input. You can provide a different string of bits to this antenna, a different string of bits to this antenna, and a different string of bits to this antenna. Now we understand the meaning of multiple input, right? Because we can provide multiple input strings of bits. And the transmitter will be able to transmit each of these string, right, to impress them on a signal and transmit the signal to the receiver in parallel.
